text: Employees accrue twenty-five days of paid leave each year. Up to five unused days may be carried into the next calendar year; the rest expire on March 31. Requests go to your manager at least two weeks ahead.
Working from home is allowed up to three days a week after the probation period. Core hours are ten to four, when everyone should be reachable on chat.
Submit receipts within thirty days. Purchases above 500 euros need written approval from a department head before you buy. Meals while travelling are reimbursed up to 40 euros a day.
On your first day IT hands you a laptop with disk encryption enabled. Install the company password manager and enrol two-factor authentication before accessing any system.
Passwords must be at least fourteen characters. Reuse of the last ten passwords is blocked. Rotate shared service credentials every ninety days using the secrets vault.
When production is down, the on-call engineer opens an incident channel, assigns an incident commander, and posts a status update every thirty minutes until service is restored.
A blameless postmortem is written within five working days of every severity one incident. It lists the timeline, the root cause, what went well, and concrete action items with owners.
Deployments to production happen on weekdays before three in the afternoon. Every release needs one approved review and a green pipeline. Friday releases require a manager's explicit sign-off.
To roll back a bad release, run the rollback job in the pipeline and select the previous tag. Database migrations are forward-only, so schema changes must be backwards compatible.
Databases are snapshotted nightly and kept for thirty-five days. A restore drill runs every quarter; the last drill restored the main cluster in forty minutes.
Meetings need an agenda shared the day before. If there is no agenda, decline. Notes and decisions are posted in the team channel within an hour.
Each candidate gets a phone screen, a take-home exercise of at most three hours, and a panel interview. Feedback must be written within twenty-four hours of each stage.
Reviews happen twice a year, in June and December. You write a self assessment, collect feedback from three peers, and discuss goals for the next half with your manager.
Birth parents receive sixteen weeks of fully paid leave and non-birth parents receive eight weeks. Leave can be taken in blocks during the first year.
If you lose a company device or suspect a phishing email, report it to the security desk immediately by phone or through the report button. Do not try to investigate on your own.
Customer data is deleted ninety days after an account is closed. Logs containing personal data are anonymised after thirty days.
Pull requests should stay under four hundred lines. Reviewers respond within one working day. Authors resolve every comment before merging; squash merges keep history linear.
New features need unit tests, and bug fixes need a regression test that fails without the fix. Flaky tests are quarantined within a day and fixed within a week.
Public API changes are additive within a major version. Breaking changes ship in a new major version, and the old one is supported for twelve months after the announcement.
Each API key is limited to six hundred requests per minute. When the limit is exceeded the server answers 429 with a Retry-After header telling the client how long to wait.
Error E-4471 means the upload checksum did not match the stored object. Retry once; if it persists, contact support with the request identifier.
Invoice INV-2025-0099 was issued to the Northwind account for the annual licence and is payable within net thirty days.
The Tel Aviv office is open from eight to eight. Visitors must be registered at reception in advance and wear a badge at all times.
Book flights through the travel portal at least fourteen days ahead. Economy class is standard for flights under six hours.
Monitors, keyboards and chairs can be ordered once from the equipment catalogue; the home office budget is 600 euros per person every three years.
Each person has a yearly learning budget of 1500 euros for courses, books and conferences. Share what you learned in a short talk at the monthly demo day.
On-call rotations last one week. The engineer on call carries the pager, answers within ten minutes, and receives a day off in lieu after a weekend shift.
Dashboards show latency, error rate and saturation for each service. Alerts page a human only when users are affected; everything else creates a ticket.
Priority one tickets get a first response within one hour, around the clock. Priority three tickets are answered within two working days.
The team plan costs twelve euros per seat per month, billed annually. Education and non-profit organisations get a fifty percent discount on request.
This quarter we focus on faster page loading, better search, and the import tool for existing documents. Mobile editing is planned for next quarter.
Use the primary teal for buttons and links, and keep at least a four to one contrast ratio between text and background. The logo needs clear space equal to its height.
Every screen must work with a keyboard alone and with a screen reader. Images need alternative text, and colour is never the only way to show a state.
A workspace is the top-level container for an organisation. Inside it, collections group related pages, and people get access to a collection through groups or individually.
Search looks at titles and page text. Put a word in quotation marks to match it exactly, and use the filter to limit results to one collection.
Deleted pages stay in the trash for thirty days and can be restored by anyone who could edit them. After that they are removed permanently.
Pages are private to their collection. To share outside the workspace, an administrator must invite the guest, who then gets read-only access to chosen collections.
You can import a zip of Markdown files. The importer keeps the folder structure, rewrites links between pages and skips files it cannot read, which it lists in a report.
מדיניות החופשה: כל עובד צובר עשרים וחמישה ימי חופשה בשנה. ניתן להעביר עד חמישה ימים לשנה הבאה, והבקשות מוגשות למנהל לפחות שבועיים מראש.
בעת תקלה בייצור, המהנדס התורן פותח ערוץ אירוע, ממנה מנהל אירוע ומעדכן את הסטטוס כל שלושים דקות עד לחזרת השירות.
הסיסמאות חייבות לכלול לפחות ארבע עשרה תווים. אסור להשתמש שוב בעשר הסיסמאות האחרונות, ויש להפעיל אימות דו שלבי.
הצוות נפגש בכל יום ראשון בבוקר לתכנון השבוע. הסיכום והמשימות מתפרסמים בערוץ הצוות.
The cafeteria serves lunch from noon to two. Vegetarian and vegan options are marked, and allergens are listed on the board next to the register.
Employees may park in the underground garage after registering their plate number. Bicycles have a covered rack by the east entrance.
New hires are paired with a mentor for the first six months. Pairs meet every two weeks and the mentor is not the new person's manager.
Everyone completes the annual security awareness course within the first month and then once a year. Completion is tracked, and access is paused for anyone who is overdue.
